title: A Busy Saturday
description: Four short recordings about a Saturday: a café, a school trip, a phone message and a shop.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · At the café
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and Anna in a café.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Hi, Tom! Sorry I'm late. The bus was very slow this morning.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: That's OK, Anna. I came at ten o'clock, so I only waited fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: What are you drinking?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: A hot chocolate. It's really good here. Do you want one?

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: No, thanks. I don't like hot drinks. I'd like an orange juice, please.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Are you hungry? They have cheese sandwiches and chocolate cake.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Yes, I am. I'll have a cheese sandwich. Cake is for my birthday!

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK. The juice is two pounds and the sandwich is three pounds. That's five pounds.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Here you are. And after this, can we go to the park? It's sunny today.

parts.title: Part 2 · A school trip
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Mrs Green, talking to her class about a trip.

script.speaker: Mrs Green
script.text: Good morning, everyone. Next Monday, we're going on a trip to the zoo.

script.speaker: Mrs Green
script.text: The bus leaves from the school gate at half past eight. Please don't be late!

script.speaker: Mrs Green
script.text: At the zoo, we can see lions, monkeys and elephants. My favourite animals are the penguins.

script.speaker: Mrs Green
script.text: Please bring a packed lunch and a bottle of water. You don't need money.

script.speaker: Mrs Green
script.text: Wear comfortable shoes, because we're going to walk a lot. And bring a coat. It can be cold in the afternoon.

script.speaker: Mrs Green
script.text: We come back to school at three o'clock. Your parents can meet you here.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear a message from Sam's dad.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Hi, Sam. It's Dad. I'm still at work, and I'm going to be home late tonight, at about seven o'clock.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Mum is at Grandma's house, so can you help me? There's some pasta in the fridge. Please put it in the oven at six.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Your football boots are in the car. I can bring them home tonight.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Oh, and please take the dog for a walk. Not a long walk, just to the end of the street.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Don't play computer games all evening! Do your homework first. See you later. Bye!

parts.title: Part 4 · In a clothes shop
parts.intro: You will hear Ben talking to a shop assistant.

script.speaker: Assistant
script.text: Hello. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes, please. I'm looking for a T-shirt for my brother. It's his birthday tomorrow.

script.speaker: Assistant
script.text: How old is he?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: He's twelve. He likes football, and his favourite colour is green.

script.speaker: Assistant
script.text: We have this green T-shirt with a football on it. It's fifteen pounds.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Oh, that's nice, but it's very big. Do you have a small one?

script.speaker: Assistant
script.text: Yes, here's a small one. And today, all T-shirts are ten pounds.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Great! I'll take it. Can I pay by card?

script.speaker: Assistant
script.text: Of course. Would you like a bag?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: No, thank you. I've got my school bag.
